$Comment: The skeleton every Hallow's Eve achievement inherits through Parent. It is never earned.
Occurrence ties an achievement to the Hallows_Eve calendar event: the library keeps one copy a
year, named <id>_<year>, that counts only while that year's event runs and stays a feat for
whoever earned it. Listing files every one under the Seasons category, in the Hallows_Eve
subcategory, which is where the Almanac and The Hallowed look for them. A child that writes
its own Listing keeps these two leaves and adds its own.
This file sits outside the _Hallows_Eve folder on purpose: its file name already spells its
id, so Parent names it the same way in the game and in the build's own content check.
